items.what: Change requests visitors send through Scout Chat: the request in their words, their name, email and phone, and the page
items.where: This website's database, as private change request posts (the Requests screen)
items.kept: Until someone deletes it. Deleting the plugin keeps the request list. The site's privacy tools export a request by the email the visitor gave; the eraser tool keeps the request and takes out their name, email and phone.
items.shared: Scout's Client Hub reads the request and the visitor's name through the site's Hub key, with email addresses and phone numbers blanked first. Only when a Hub key is set.
items.when: only when Scout Chat is on and a visitor asks for a change there

items.what: The visitor's name and the first words of a chat change request, as a line in the Site log
items.where: This website's database, as a private Site log line
items.kept: Until someone deletes it. Deleting the plugin keeps the Site log. The site's privacy eraser tool replaces the name with Scout Chat.
items.shared: Scout's Client Hub, which reads the Site log through the site's Hub key, only when a Hub key is set
items.when: only when Scout Chat is on and a visitor asks for a change there

items.what: Names or emails and short previews of waiting visitor messages (chat questions, booking requests, new reviews and similar)
items.where: Read from the plugins that hold them and listed in Inbox emails. This plugin keeps no copy.
items.shared: Emailed to site staff who turned on Inbox emails
items.when: only for staff who chose daily or every-item Inbox emails

items.what: Every email the website sends, including form notices, booking and chat emails, and replies to visitors, which can carry what visitors typed
items.where: Sent through the Google mailbox set on the Email screen. This plugin keeps no copy.
items.shared: Google (Gmail), which sends the site's email
items.when: only when the Email screen has a Google address and app password

notes: This plugin sets no cookies and collects nothing from visitors itself. The items above come from other Scout plugins, mainly Scout Chat, and from how the site's email is sent.
